active.title: RULE 1 — DRAFT ORDER
active.text:
The regular-season standings determine the draft order for the following season.

The draft is traditional/linear, NOT snake.

This is intended to discourage tanking or failure to set competitive lineups during the playoffs by teams no longer competing for the championship.

The final four draft positions will be randomly selected.

active.title: COMMISSIONER RULE — KEEPER DECLARATION / TRADING FREEZE
active.text:
A keeper-declaration period will open before the draft.

Ample time will be given to all owners to declare their keepers.

Trading will close after the keeper-declaration period ends. This will generally be for one or two days immediately before the draft.

Trading will reopen once the owner with the #1 overall pick is officially on the clock for their first selection.

active.title: COMMISSIONER RULE — MISSED KEEPER DEADLINE
active.text: Failure to declare keepers before the keeper-declaration period ends results in the loss of ALL KEEPERS for that owner.

active.title: COMMISSIONER RULE — DRAFT PICK TRADING
active.text:
Draft picks #1, #2 and #3 cannot be traded.

Pick #4 is considered a first-round draft pick and MAY be traded.

Therefore, if an owner wants to trade a "first-round pick" for a major player, Pick #4 is the earliest allowable pick.

proposed.title: PROPOSED RULE — TEAM NAME FREEZE
proposed.text:
Once the draft begins, team names are frozen for the season.

An owner may change their team name after the draft begins, but doing so will cost that owner BOTH:

- their first-round draft pick
- their second-round draft pick
proposed.status: PROPOSED — NOT CURRENTLY A LEAGUE RULE
